Roboto and Roboto Mono (latin subset, woff2) from the fontsource npm packages @fontsource/roboto and
@fontsource/roboto-mono 5.3.0, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (LICENSE-*).
Self-hosted: the docs must not load anything from external servers (Material loads the theme fonts from Google
Fonts otherwise, see theme.font: false in mkdocs.yml). Included via extra_css (fonts.css).
